_readme: Human decisions about messy source data. Edited by hand, read by scripts/build-data.mjs.
Everything here persists across rebuilds, so you never review the same row twice.
See the 'did you mean' suggestions in data/qa-report.md for ready-to-paste entries.
_universityAliases: Spelling (lowercased) -> canonical university id. Adds to scripts/universities-map.mjs without editing code.
_ignoreUniversities: Known junk. Silenced in the QA report so real problems aren't buried.
_programMerges: Duplicate program ids judged to be the same program: '<from id>': '<into id>'. Check the 'Possible duplicate programs' section of the QA report first — co-op vs non-co-op are genuinely different.
_programIgnore: Program ids to drop entirely (spam, test rows).
